subject: math
verificationNotes: Hand-authored; numeric answers checked with sympy.

items.prompt:
Estimate $50$, margin $3$: plausible range is:
A) $47$ to $53$
B) $50$ to $53$
C) $3$ to $50$
D) $45$ to $55$

To generalize to a population, the sample must be:
A) large only
B) random from that population
C) convenient
D) biased

A cause-and-effect claim requires a:
A) survey
B) observational study
C) randomized experiment
D) large sample

A poll of only gym members can generalize to:
A) all adults
B) gym members
C) athletes worldwide
D) no one

steps: Only the sampled population. Key is B.

items.prompt:
An observational study can establish:
A) causation
B) association
C) nothing
D) random assignment

Increasing a random sample size generally makes the margin of error:
A) larger
B) smaller
C) unchanged
D) negative

Random SELECTION supports generalization; random ASSIGNMENT supports:
A) bias
B) causation
C) larger margins
D) nonresponse

steps: Assignment enables causal claims. Key is B.

items.prompt:
A statistic computed from a sample is used to estimate a population:
A) sample
B) parameter
C) margin
D) residual

steps: Parameters are the targets. Key is B.
